Removing/adding users to groups can be done in AAD/Intune.

First we need a spreadsheet of users that we want to apply the users to.

Head to AD manager - Reports - All users, then click add OU's.

Here, we can export a list of users depending on the group/location they are associated with.

For this example, we are adding all Luxembourg users to a group in order to trigger Micollab uninstalls on their devices

![[Pasted image 20241231122702.png]]

Go to staff accounts and select the jurisdiction

Export as CSV (top right)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Once file downloaded, open. Should look similar to this

![](data:image/png;base64,)

In AAD, find the group you're looking to change members for (if not in favourites, search for groups in the 'all services tab)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Head into the group

![[Pasted image 20241231122742.png]]

![[Pasted image 20241231122834.png]]

![[Pasted image 20241231122842.png]]

Import all user email and add into collum A line 3 (deleting the example section)

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Go back to

![](data:image/png;base64,)

Upload the file

Can keep track of the devices by going to the app that’s getting uninstalled and checking the stats
